The '''''Potala Um Var''''' was a [[Warship/Legends|warship]] commanded by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Ulal]] and used to patrol the [[Varl system/Legends|Ardos system]]. Its name meant "eternal vigilance."<ref name="LoNH" />
